name: @bureaucromancer/lantern-server
filesNote: `src` ships beside `dist` because every source map and declaration map names its source as `../src/…`: without it, go-to-definition in a consumer and `node --enable-source-maps` stack traces lead to files that do not exist. Tests, their helpers and their snapshots stay out, as does the build info. tools/pack-shape.test.ts checks the packed list.
scriptsNote: `dev` runs from packages/server, so `../../data` is the repository's gitignored data/ directory; `--config` points there too (a missing file means defaults), so a developer's real platform lantern.json never reaches the dev daemon. The Vite dev server proxies /api with changeOrigin (Host becomes the daemon's) but keeps the browser's Origin, which is why the dev origin is allowlisted here rather than rewritten in the proxy. `emit-openapi` runs the script with Node's built-in type stripping; the script imports the built app from dist, so the spec describes what ships.
dependencyNote: Fastify 5 (5.12.5, deliberately not StoryEngine's 5.12.0, which has seven published advisories, four of them high; 5.12.5 fixes them all and was the newest release at least two weeks old; StoryEngine should bump too, and tools/advisory-floors.test.ts keeps the lockfile from going back) with @fastify/static (serves the built app), @fastify/cookie (the session cookie, signed by hand) and @fastify/swagger (the OpenAPI spec is generated from route schemas, rule 1). Ajv is declared directly because the server installs its own non-rewriting instance (rule 5) and the schema package must stay TypeBox-only. @fastify/type-provider-typebox is imported for types only: 5.2.0 is the last line that accepts @sinclair/typebox 0.34, and its validator compiler is never used. write-file-atomic does temp-write, fsync and rename, plus mode and cleanup handling that hand-rolled versions get wrong; it ships no types, so src/types/write-file-atomic.d.ts declares the surface we call.
